purpose: Review accumulated resource-aware and Work Observatory evidence for next-signal thresholds without activating S18, benchmarks, dashboards or runtime collection.

records_reviewed.signal_input: human expertise and evidence-based learning record

repeated_comparable_slices.reason: Five total records exist, but no record has a reviewed stable comparison_group.

repeated_late_stage_waste.reason: No repeated late-stage waste pattern is source-backed across comparable slices.

repeated_local_translations.reason: No repeated local rule translation is present across multiple projects.

stable_reinforced_outcomes.reason: Outcomes are useful but not comparable enough to claim a stable reinforced pattern.

threshold_decision.reason: The available records are source-backed but heterogeneous. They do not clear the next-signals threshold for S18 comparative metrics, benchmark packaging or 1.3+ reopening.
required_before_reopen: at least two believable real slices with comparable review language for a next-signals record
at least five reviewed records in one stable comparison_group before S18 comparative work metrics
explicit human decision before any benchmark or 1.3+ framing
